newsitem.title: USA: Encore Wire stake lifted by Vinik group.
newsitem.headline: Encore Wire stake lifted by Vinik group.

text.p: A group led by Boston investor Jeffrey Vinik said Friday it raised its stake in Encore Wire Corp to 558,800 common shares or 7.9 percent.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include the purchase of 80,500 common shares between February 11 and February 20 at prices ranging from $19.6638 to $20.1250 per share.
The group holds the stake for investment purposes.
The McKinney, Texas-based company is a low-cost manufacturer of copper electrical wire for commercial, industrial and residential use.
